extracted.name: Spicy Feta Cheese Dip
extracted.description: This spicy feta cheese dip is great on pitas, used as a dip, or served alongside souvlaki.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
1 pound feta cheese, cut into small cubes
instruction_lines: Combine olive oil, yogurt, lemon juice, paprika, garlic, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and sugar in a food processor; pulse mixture until smooth. Add a couple of feta cubes at a time, processing between batches until mixture is thick and smooth.
Transfer dip to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
